body_height_method: One fixed manually measured standing crown-to-projected-boot-sole-contact-midpoint scale from plant; excludes axe and scarf. Crouched/twisted frames are not individually normalized.

atlas_layout.source_cell_policy: Adaptive disjoint rectangles for bottom contact/follow separator x=549. Consume explicit region, never derive a fixed 512x512 frame crop.

frames.name: plant
frames.pose: Low rear/left-loaded wide planted stance; chest and face remain southeast/right.

frames.name: coil
frames.pose: Left/rear hip coil below shoulders, hands on continuous axe haft; chest and face remain southeast/right.

frames.name: drive
frames.pose: Pre-contact horizontal lateral drive from left toward right across the waist.

frames.name: contact
frames.pose: Release: front-facing southeast/right chest and face; both arms extend right, silver axe blade is far screen-right beyond the body and foot midpoint.

frames.name: follow
frames.pose: Recovery follow-through remains front-right-facing with axe settling on same right target side, no opposite-side second hit.

frames.name: ready
frames.pose: Restore low two-handed axe-ready stance; face and chest remain southeast/right.

registration.coordinates: All positions and rectangles use absolute original PNG pixels. Rectangle arrays are [x,y,width,height].
registration.foot: Arithmetic midpoint of independently reviewed projected sole contact centers of both boots, approximately +/-6 source pixels.
registration.head: Highest crown/hair point of the anatomical head, approximately +/-5 source pixels; excludes scarf and axe.
registration.grip: Midpoint of the two hands gripping the continuous axe haft, approximately +/-10 source pixels; a supporting hand may be partly occluded.
registration.muzzle: Legacy key: center of the outer silver axe cutting edge, approximately +/-10 source pixels. This is an axe contact anchor, not a firearm muzzle.
registration.crop_note: Each complete visible alpha>16 bounding rectangle plus 8px padding is within its disjoint source_cell. Raw PNG copied byte-for-byte; no figure rectangle contains neighbor fragments. Near-zero alpha noise retained.

alpha.inspection: Read-only Pillow measurements; raw PNG copied byte-for-byte without cropping, scaling, compositing or alpha edits.

New contact(index3) blade is clearly screen-right while face/chest remain southeast/right. Cutting edge x=458 exceeds projected foot midpoint x=231.5 by 226.5px.
Follow(index4) stays front/right-facing and blade remains right of body, settling on the same target side without an opposite-side second hit.

Six distinct complete full bodies with one two-handed axe each; same clean-shaven adult male, dark brown hair, orange-red scarf and charcoal/copper-gold armor. No gun, hammer, helmet, ground, cast shadow, VFX, labels or text.
